mainText: This is the Gaza Dispatch audio briefing for September 11, 2026. Here are the key source-backed developments from today's edition. 1. Settlers, soldiers, and Israeli impunity in the West Bank. Armed settlers in military uniforms are seizing land and attacking Palestinian communities with near-total impunity. This was reported by Al Jazeera. 2. From hunger crisis to 'obesity': how Gaza's UN data is being twisted. US and Israeli officials are using a drop in acute malnutrition cases to claim Gaza has no hunger. This was reported by Al Jazeera.
